title: Scratch vertex/index buffer allocation
summary: Recovers the thiscall allocator at 0x5429a0 with D3D9 COM slot calls, signed HRESULT handling, first-resource cleanup, device retention and original field write order. Direct Game.exe disassembly and four caller sites corroborate the accepted reference.
test_description: Original and recovered calls run against the same instrumented stdcall COM callbacks. Cartesian inputs cover low-byte flags including upper-only bits, zero/normal/max vertex sizes, index shift wrap boundaries, signed failure and nonzero successful HRESULTs, and output writes or non-writes. Checks verify argument slots, output addresses, callback order and callback-visible object state, return values, cleanup, retained device, sizes, cursors and untouched fields on failures.
known_limits: Tests model COM callbacks rather than invoking a real Direct3D driver. Invalid pointers and a successful first allocation yielding null before second-call failure retain the original unchecked dereference behavior and are not executed.
Field names are semantic inferences from D3D9 arguments and caller usage; no byte-matching claim is made.
32-bit ABI layout is required for original binary interoperability; native 64-bit ports naturally widen pointers.
